title: Dubrovnik Cathedral
visualBrief: Individual Dubrovnik Cathedral: pale coursed limestone Baroque front, four free-standing columns/recessed wood entry beneath canopy, two side doors, outer figure niches, shoulder balustrades/statues and upper rectangular glazing/shallow balcony/volutes/triangular crown. Gray metal nave/aisle/transept roofs; central pale windowed drum, dark gray ribbed dome and slender pale lantern/finial/cross. Side upper windows/lower lunettes and broad transept glazing/door complete map-led body. Four existing shared limestone/continuous limestone/standing-seam metal/wood graphs, linear tints, metric UVs and four browser levels. Fine Corinthian carving/statue identity/ironwork, full interiors, exact hidden rear details and surveyed paving/thresholds are approximate or excluded.
